text: Create and manage repositories, browse commit history and code files in the web interface
quote: Gitea supports creating and managing repositories, browsing commit history and code files, reviewing and merging code submissions, managing collaborators, handling branches, and more.

text: Review and merge code submissions, manage collaborators, and handle branches
quote: Gitea supports creating and managing repositories, browsing commit history and code files, reviewing and merging code submissions, managing collaborators, handling branches, and more.

text: Built-in CI/CD (Gitea Actions) with YAML workflows compatible with GitHub Actions, reusing existing Actions plugins
quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.

text: Actions plugins can be downloaded from any Git website
quote: Actions plugins support downloading from any Git website.

text: Code review via Pull Request and AGit workflows, with reviewers browsing code online and leaving comments
quote: Code review supports both the Pull Request workflow and AGit workflow. Reviewers can browse code online and provide review comments or feedback.

text: Submitters can respond to review comments and modify code online
quote: Submitters can receive review comments and respond or modify code online.

text: Extend functionality and build custom workflows with an API and webhooks
quote: Extend Gitea's functionality with our API and webhooks, creating custom workflows to match your unique needs.

text: Public or private package registry supporting 20+ formats including npm, PyPI, Maven, Cargo, Helm, and containers
quote: Gitea supports over 20 different types of public or private software package management, including Cargo, Chef, Composer, Conan, Conda, Container, Helm, Maven, npm, NuGet, Pub, PyPI, RubyGems, Vagrant, and more.

text: Manage requirements, features, and bugs with issue tasks, labels, and kanban boards
quote: Efficiently manage requirements, features, and bugs through issue tasks, labels, and kanban boards.

text: Issues support milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, and dependencies
quote: Issues support features like branches, tags, milestones, assignments, time tracking, due dates, dependencies, and more.

text: User permission management and access control lists to secure code and data
quote: offering features such as user permission management, access control lists, and more to ensure the security of code and data.

text: Audit logging of activity for security
quote: offering features such as user permission management, access control lists, audit logging, and more to ensure the security of code and data.

text: Sync with chat tools such as Slack, Discord, MS Teams, and Lark
quote: Sync seamlessly with tools like Slack, Discord, MS Teams, Lark, and more.

text: Easy deployment on various servers without complex configuration or dependencies, letting individual developers and small teams run their own Git service
quote: It can be easily deployed on various servers without complex configurations or dependencies. This makes it convenient for individual developers or small teams to set up and manage their own Git services.

text: Runs on Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, and Kubernetes across x86 and arm64 architectures
quote: Universally compatible with diverse operating systems and environments, including Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, and Kubernetes. Compatible with multiple architectures, such as x86 and arm64.

text: Supports SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB, and MS SQL databases
quote: Offers seamless integration with leading databases, including SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB, and MS SQL.

text: Can run on a Raspberry Pi 3 for small workloads
quote: A Raspberry Pi 3 is powerful enough to run Gitea for small workloads.

text: Deployment as a single server or in replication configurations
quote: Provides flexible deployment options, supporting both single server setups and replication configurations.

text: Migrate repositories from Gogs to Gitea
quote: The recommended method is to migrate repositories from Gogs to Gitea.

text: Interface available in multiple languages for internationalization and localization
quote: Gitea provides interfaces in multiple languages, catering to users globally and promoting internationalization and localization.

text: Integrations with GitHub Actions, Drone, Woodpecker, Argo CD, and Jenkins
quote: Improve workflows with integrations like GitHub Actions, Drone, Woodpecker, Argo CD, and Jenkins, among others.

text: Dynamic configuration options can be changed from the admin panel
quote: For dynamic config options, you can change it on your admin panel's configuration section.

text: Managed hosted environment with a choice of provider and region
quote: Launch a managed environment for teams that want speed, support, and low operational overhead. Choose your provider and region

text: Git Large File Storage support when enabled
quote: Git Large File Storage will be available if enabled and if your Git version is >= 2.1.2

text: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license with unlimited users and repositories
quote: Free, self-hosted Git service under the MIT license. Full control, unlimited users and repositories.
